targeted_related_records.hypothesis: Within-superpoint native point detail is lost by mean pooling although partitions remain adequate; a query-conditioned point field can represent annotated point boundaries without changing query selection or superpoint supports.

Fine-cell mean aggregation can erase feature-position cross moments. Establish whether actual M95 is blind to a within-cell feature permutation changing those moments, then measure task relevance with the same native TRAIN prefix and criterion. A mathematical nullspace alone is not a task deficit or attention admission.

Coarse scene tokens can define context-dependent channel relationships while each fine token retains its own spatially local values. A coarse-derived grouped channel operator may improve fine semantic interpretation before original HCG readback; efficacy unknown until native training.

A coarse-to-fine affine prolongation may transmit coarse semantic intercepts while keeping child variation related to actual geometry. It replaces fine/middle independent semantic constants and non-affine variation with parent intercept plus geometric-subspace projection; task efficacy unknown.

One shared original-ancestry triplet factor jointly transforms fine/middle/coarse inputs and returns direct fine plus fixed-mean upper messages before unchanged raw skips/HCG; whole-graph alternative, efficacy unknown.

A shared nonlinear factor on each unordered length-two wedge of the original true-supported hierarchy, followed by equal factor-incidence readout into all three nodes, may offer a useful point-feature composition distinct from ancestor-only triplets or iterative node/edge states. Task efficacy and novelty UNKNOWN.

Identity-core real-arithmetic inversion is only a software property; task efficacy, novelty and whole-model invertibility UNKNOWN.

A shared nonlinear eight-vertex inclusion-exclusion interaction on each true fine ancestry path may produce a useful alternative hierarchy delta before original HCG/single inst_feats. Ordinary mixed finite-difference family; usefulness, population bottleneck and novelty UNKNOWN.

distinction: New statistics start from valid native point_feats, retaining within-fine variation at equal original fine means. Fixed private total-variance decomposition and top-down between-child dispersion feed one shared packed nonlinear map. This is not the old token-only hierarchy state/path/factor, coarse-derived channel attention, feature-position cross-moment audit, geometric affine prolongation, or query-conditioned per-point mask field.
